item.title: [KOR] Introduction to "From the Transistor"
item.description: In this post, I’ve written past, current, and future of ‘From the Transistor’ project. Summarize each project secion with an expected output and what should I prepare to achieve the section goal. During about 3 weeks, I have made an ARM assembler and CPU, which is working now. There are numerous things what I have laerned for this period. It’s not perfect yet, but keep better.
